english.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for someone who reliably fulfills their duties.

examples.english: They are always dutiful at work, so no one worries about tasks assigned to them.
examples.traditional: 佢做嘢一向好盡責，交畀佢嘅工作從來唔使人擔心。
